Australia-ASO-problems.json.verification_notes: The Australian Science Olympiad Exam in Biology (the national IBO selection exam), one record per question with every option, table and figure, transcribed from the official question paper published by Australian Science Innovations and checked against its page images. Statements only: no answers. © Australian Science Innovations.

Canada-NBC-problems.json.verification_notes: The National Biology Competition of the University of Toronto (Canada), one record per multiple-choice question with every option, table and figure, transcribed from the official exam paper published on the competition site and checked against its page images. Statements only: no answers or answer keys. The questions remain the work of the University of Toronto National Biology Competition.

IBO-practical-problems.json.verification_notes: Practical exams, one record per printed part or task with its protocol, data, figures and every question, transcribed from the official English paper of the IBO examination papers archive and checked against its page images. Statements only: no answers, answer keys or marking schemes. IBO examination papers © International Biology Olympiad, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

IBO-theory-problems.json.verification_notes: Theoretical papers only (practical exams are not included). One record per question, with every statement or option, table and figure, transcribed from the official English paper of the IBO examination papers archive and checked against its page images. Statements only: no answers, answer keys or solutions. IBO examination papers © International Biology Olympiad, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

IJSO-biology-problems.json.verification_notes: The biology questions of the IJSO multiple-choice papers (the papers mix physics, chemistry and biology; only the questions whose content is biology are kept, with their printed numbers), one record per question with every option, table and figure, transcribed from the official English paper on ijsoweb.org and checked against its page images. Statements only: no answers or solutions.

India-INBO-problems.json.verification_notes: The INBO theory paper (Sections A and B, numbered as printed), one record per question with every option, table and figure, transcribed from the official English question paper published by HBCSE-TIFR and checked against its page images. Statements only: no answers or solutions. The questions remain the work of HBCSE and the INBO problem setters.

India-NSEB-problems.json.verification_notes: The NSEB (IAPT, with the Association of Teachers in Biological Sciences), the first stage of the Indian biology olympiad programme: one record per question with every option, table and figure, transcribed from the official question paper published by IAPT and checked against its page images. Statements only: no answers or answer keys.

Japan-JBO-problems.json.verification_notes: English translations of the question statements of the Japan Biology Olympiad (JBO) 1st- and 2nd-round examinations, published with the written permission of the International Biology Olympiad Japan Committee (29 October 2026). Each problem is labelled as an English translation of the JBO original, © International Biology Olympiad Japan Committee (JBO), with links to the JBO past-papers page and the original PDF. Statements only: no answers or answer keys. Any problem is corrected or removed immediately at the JBO's request.

NewZealand-NZIBO-problems.json.verification_notes: The NZIBO national entrance examination (and the 2011 selection examination), one record per question with every option, statement, table and figure, transcribed from the official paper published by NZIBO and checked against its page images. Statements only: no answers. © NZIBO.

Switzerland-SBO-problems.json.verification_notes: English translations of the question statements of the Swiss Biology Olympiad 1st- and 2nd-round exams, published with the written permission of the Swiss Biology Olympiad (27 October 2026). Each question is labelled as an English translation of the original (German edition; the exams also exist in French and Italian), with a link to the archive and the original PDF. Statements only: no solutions. Exam questions © Swiss Biology Olympiad (Wissenschafts-Olympiade). Any question is corrected or removed immediately at the organisers' request.
